cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put a strip of tape on the box, like you did. That's the packing you asked for, finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's a label. Tape across the opening so the books don't fall out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. One strip across the opening. I've done exactly what you asked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It won't reach both sides. Use two strips long enough to close it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two long strips, then. That's this box closed. Bring me the next instruction when you want the next box done.
